Class RouxCounters

java.lang.Object
org.roux.tel.RouxCounters
@Component public class RouxCounters extends Object
The RouxCounters type holds the live counters for the memory engine. Each counter is an atomic long in this process. snapshot() copies them into a MemoryTelemetry. Later increments stay on these counters. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxCounters roux-design.md

  • Method Details

    • snapshot

      public MemoryTelemetry snapshot()
      The method copies the counters into a MemoryTelemetry. The fragmentation index is one minus the hot used bytes divided by the capacity. The capacity is the allocated-page count times 1048576. A capacity below 1 is treated as 1. A negative index is stored as 0.
      Returns:
      The snapshot is the copied counters.
